mode.description: Set to true to operate as a proxy detector (-p). Default is false (standard SSH/version scan).

no_ssh_id.description: Set to true to not send a SSH identification string (-I).

ports.description: List of port numbers to scan. If mode is proxy, default ports may vary, but 22 is standard for SSH.

scanners.description: List of scanners to run. Options: ssh, socks5, socks4, http-proxy, http-connect, telnet-proxy.

socks_proxies.description: List of SOCKS proxy host:port strings to use for scanning (-u).

exclude_file.description: Path to the file containing addresses to exclude from the scan (-e).

exit_on_exclude_missing.description: Set to true to exit if the exclude file cannot be found (-E).

ignore_exclude_random.description: Set to true to ignore excluded addresses when generating random addresses (-R).

targets.description: List of target networks or IPs. Can include CIDR, single IPs, or complex expressions like 'random(n,seed)/split(s,e)/address'. Each item is a single string.
